title: Size bound for a wise independent multiset
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $A$ assign a sign vector in $\{-1,1\}^{n}$ to each element of $\Omega$. If the resulting multiset is $k$-wise independent, then $\binom{n}{\lfloor k/2\rfloor}\leq |\Omega|$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ maps each element of $\Omega$ to a sign vector of length $n$
the multiset defined by $A$ is $k$-wise independent
